original_finding_content.subject: YouTube SD-03 — general absence finding
original_finding_content.raw_text:
`site:youtube.com hotmart experiencia vendedor 2025`; `site:youtube.com hotmart ingresos resultados vendedor`; `site:youtube.com "hotmart" "mi experiencia" ventas`; `site:youtube.com hotmart ganancias cuanto gané`; `youtube hotmart experiencia vendedor español 2025 2026`. All returned zero YouTube video results or only blog/TikTok content.  
**Notes:** SD-03. YouTube site: queries consistently returned zero results. YouTube video pages could not be directly fetched. The search infrastructure may be filtering or deprioritizing YouTube video URLs, or this content type is sparse in Spanish.
